project_line: Sample Elementary School HVAC Replacement  |  Weekly Owner, Engineer, Contractor Meeting
location: Video call plus on site at Sample Elementary School
prepared_by: Pat Doe, Project Manager, Example Mechanical, LLC
attendance_note: Not in attendance: the controls subcontractor (copied).

sections.title: Purpose
items: Weekly Owner, Engineer, and Contractor progress meeting. Items below were discussed and direction was given as noted.

sections.title: Schedule
items: RTU-1 is set and connected. RTU-2 is scheduled to be set next week, weather permitting.
Start up is planned after both units are set and the controls are terminated.

sections.title: RFIs and Change Orders
items: RFI-001 (RTU-2 curb adapter) is open. The Engineer will respond by the next meeting.
PCO-001 was submitted for the added curb adapter. The Owner will review it after the RFI-001 response.

sections.title: Electrical
items: The sub reported the new disconnect for RTU-1 is installed. RTU-2 power will be pulled after the unit is set.

sections.title: Next Meeting
items: Next meeting is Wednesday, January 21, 2026, 1:00 PM, same format.

action_items.action: Review PCO-001 after the RFI-001 response
Pull power to RTU-2 after it is set
